messages:
Devon: Heads-up — our eu-west-1 GPU Savings Plan (p4d/p4de mix) expires in 18 days and current coverage is weirdly skewed. Dashboard shows 62% coverage for GPU hours overall but only ~40% for the p4d-heavy workload. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/boards/savings/1812345678 :eyes:

Sasha: Oof. Is that 40% calculated against billable GPU hours or instance-hours?

Devon: Billable GPU hours. I ran a quick breakdown by tag (team:vision, env:prod) — vision-prod is the biggest offender. Looks like a bunch of jobs shifted to eu-central for a month which dropped the eu-west SP utilization.

Marco: Can we exchange or reassign reservations? If it's a Savings Plan (compute) we can absorb cross-region if compute scope was chosen, but if it's instance-specified or regional RI that's trickier. Which SKU/plan type is this?

Devon: It's a regional Savings Plan scoped to "Compute — EC2" but when purchased we limited to x86 + p4 family filters because of price sensitivity. So not fully cross-instance-family. Long story short: we bought a p4-targeted plan that doesn't fully cover p4de in eu-central.

Priya: Quick idea: blend strategy for renewal — keep a base commitment in eu-west for 70% of historical steady-state, then buy flexible compute SP for the remaining burst (or rely on on-demand/spot for bursts). That reduces wasted commit.

Ashok: Agreed. Also consider mixing commitment terms: shorter 1-yr convertible + on-demand for the rest. Our utilization history for last 6 months: 
```
select region, instance_family, sum(billable_gpu_hours) as hours
from infra_billing
where product = 'EC2' and billable_resource like '%gpu%'
group by 1,2
order by hours desc
limit 20;
```
That query shows the hotspot families.

Devon: I ran that and attached the CSV to the thread. TL;DR: vision-prod eu-west uses ~55% p4d, 30% p4de, 15% misc; vision-prod eu-central is 70% p4de.

CostBot: auto-alert: SavingsPlan eu-west-1-p4 (id:sav-0a1b2c3d) utilization = 62%, coverage gap last 30d = 14%, recommended action: "partial-renew + region-shift assessment". See /alerts/1812345678

Sasha: Given the cross-region mismatch, two-pronged approach: 1) For this renewal window, convert 40% of the planned commit into a family-flex compute SP (to cover p4de), 2) re-evaluate steady state with a 30-day rolling window then commit the remainder to regional p4d-targeted SP in eu-west.

Marco: Operational constraints: Dedicated infra in eu-central is on our reserved pool but billed through a different account. We need accountant signoff if we want to reassign SP scope across accounts. I can open a billing ticket if we decide to move funds.

Devon: Can someone run an account-level utilization split and show the 30/60/90 day trends? I want to avoid auto-renewing at current ratios.

Priya: I'll handle 30/60/90 and include spot usage too. If we show sustained spot usage >20% for a family, it argues for conservative commit.

Ashok: Also watch the latency-sensitive workloads — if we move coverage to cheaper compute family it might increase preemption/spot risk. Keep a fallback: A/B rolling fallback to on-demand for critical routes.

Devon: For action items:
- Priya: 30/60/90 utilization split + spot fraction for p4/p4d/p4de by region (due EOD tomorrow).
- Marco: Open billing thread to see cross-account SP reallocation possibilities; tag @finance (done?)
- Sasha: Draft three renewal scenarios (Conservative 40% convertible + 60% flexible; Balanced 60% regional + 40% flexible; Aggressive 80% regional) with estimated $ delta and expected coverage.

Sasha: I'll include projected % coverage and break-even in months assuming current usage. Example calc snippet: 
```
cost_savings = (on_demand_rate - commitment_rate) * expected_hours
break_even_months = commit_cost / cost_savings_per_month
```

OpsBot: Note: Upcoming eu-west maintenance window on day 12 of the commit period might reduce billed hours temporarily. Flagged on calendar.

Devon: Thanks — if we can avoid autobuy renewal I'm leaning toward Balanced. Nobody wants to be stuck with a family-specific SP that doesn't map to actual runs.

Marco: FYI finance says we can shift up to 20% spend across sibling accounts with approval, but anything >20% needs PO and legal attached. I'll route.

Priya: Starting the data pull now. Will post CSV and a tiny viz in the thread.

Sasha: If Priya's numbers show eu-central >50% p4de for the last 60d then I will recommend 30% flexible compute + 50% regional p4d + 20% convertible.

Devon: Cool. Let's reconvene tomorrow after Priya posts. Can someone set a 15 min sync? :calendar: @Marco maybe?

Marco: 15-min slot booked for tomorrow 09:15 UTC. Invite sent to @Devon @Sasha @Priya @Ashok @finance.

Devon: Perfect — will bring sample cost projections. :thumbsup:
